title: WhatsApp OTP management
description: Monitor the live WhatsApp connection and control the session used to deliver OTP messages.

warnings.staleReadyTitle: Stored status is READY but the live WhatsApp socket is down
warnings.staleReadyDescription: This explains missing registration OTP messages. Reconnect the session, then confirm that WhatsApp Socket is up.

session.title: WhatsApp session
session.description: Persisted session state combined with the live health endpoint.
session.persistedHint: This alone does not prove the socket is connected

controls.title: Session controls
controls.description: Commands are queued to the OTP worker and status refreshes automatically.

actions.logoutConfirm: Logging out clears the current WhatsApp session and requires pairing again. Continue?
actions.accepted: Command accepted. Status will refresh automatically.

qr.title: Pair WhatsApp
qr.description: Scan the QR code when the session is waiting for pairing.
qr.instructions: Open Linked Devices in WhatsApp, choose Link a device, then scan this code.
qr.waiting: Waiting for the worker to generate a QR code.

errors.load: Could not load WhatsApp status or readiness health.
errors.action: The command failed. Check the worker status and try again.
